answer.explanation: Resident3 contributed >10 units in the last round, so punish with maximum severity affordable (floor(5.67/0.3)=18).

message.reasoning:
We need decide actions. Look at last round 8 contributions: Resident3 contributed 22.6 (>10). So rule: if any resident contributed more than 10 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with max severity affordable. Most recent round is round 8. Only Resident3 >10. So we punish Resident3. Compute severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). Wallet =5.67, cost 0.3 => floor(5.67/0.3)= floor(18.9)=18 severity. Can we afford? Cost = severity * punishment_cost = 18*0.3=5.4 which is <= wallet 5.67, so affordable. Action punish Resident3 amount 18.

We can also do a communication? At most one physical and one communication. Not required. Could also broadcast warning but not needed. We'll just punish.
